mechanism_narrative: The unemployment rate (UNRATE) is currently at 8.8%, which is above the historical median of 5.0%. This high unemployment rate signals a weak labor market, leading to reduced corporate earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 5.0%, the 20-day forward returns are not negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the CPI index above 225 (as of t-1mo) signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL is above 225, the 20-day forward returns are not negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) and declining labor force participation (PAYEMS < 130000) signals a deteriorating labor market, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.0 and PAYEMS < 130000, the 20-day forward returns are not negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), the Federal Reserve's policy rate hikes increase discount rates for equity valuation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 2.0, the 60-day forward returns are not negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 450,000 units (as of t-2mo) signals a contraction in the housing sector, reducing consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 450, the 20-day forward returns are not negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between weak industrial production (INDPRO < 90) and weak retail sales (RSAFS < 380000) signals a broad economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 90 and RSAFS < 380000, the 20-day forward returns are not negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is currently at 0.14%, which is below the historical median of 2.0%. This low interest rate environment reduces the risk-free rate, increasing the present value of equity cash flows and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%, the 20-day forward returns are not positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: The current industrial production level (INDPRO=93.59) is below the historical median of 100, indicating a slowing economy. This slowdown reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
